The bank's core banking system supports real-time transaction processing.
External SMS and Email gateways are available for notifications.

ranking.why: strict verification and validation: every build phase has a matching test phase
risk-driven loops for high uncertainty or technical risk
high regulation with evolving requirements: iterations plus V-Model verification gates
continuous secure deployment with automated security checks
short iterations absorb frequently changing requirements
rapid prototyping for small, low-risk systems

rejected.why: heavy risk analysis each loop is costly when requirements are clear
two processes to run; only pays off when requirements keep changing
its value is continuous delivery, which this project needs little of
testing comes late, so verification evidence arrives after design is locked
light documentation clashes with formal audit and sign-off
too little rigour for high-risk or regulated systems
